# How much of your Google Ads budget goes to searches that never convert?

> Free Google Ads wasted spend analyzer: drop in your search terms report CSV and see how much you spent on terms that never converted, which negative keywords are safe to add, and which converting terms deserve exact match. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
